title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Oakdale Theatre, Wallingford | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Oakdale Theatre in Wallingford, Connecticut, USA, on 4 October 2026.

It was the seventh show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s fall tour of the USA, which lasted for nine dates in September and October 2026.

Starr had previously performed at the Oakdale Theatre on 27 July 1995, 14 June 2014, and 15 September 2018.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
